purpose: Cross-repo TGA and ACEDGE operational realism pack with mixed explore-vs-prune incidents mined from real fixes.

cases.title: PATCH looked correct but partner API only accepted POST on one path
cases.symptom: Product enable requests intermittently failed with 404 on the partner endpoint even though auth and payload looked valid.
visible_evidence: Same endpoint shape sometimes accepts equivalent payloads under a different method
Failure looks transport-like, but request construction and fallback behavior both matter
A naive retry loop improves nothing when method mismatch is deterministic

starting_context.repro_style: remote call fails on one method and succeeds on method fallback

misleading_telemetry: auth checks and payload validation pass
404 suggests route issue but does not reveal method contract drift
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: add generic retries and treat rate or flake as root cause

success_criteria: identify method-contract mismatch as a first-class cause
preserve explicit fallback behavior and diagnostics for deterministic 404 method failures
cases.notes: Inspired by four-visions-big-commerce method fallback incident.

cases.title: Login looked successful but migration-era account state still broke session flow
cases.symptom: Users could authenticate but failed to land in a stable signed-in state due to legacy account mapping and auth flow divergence.
visible_evidence: Auth appears to complete, then follow-up state diverges
Behavior differs by account history and migration path
A UI-only redirect patch masks deeper identity mapping mismatch

starting_context.repro_style: first signal looks fixed until later session checks fail

replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: patch route redirect only and declare auth stable

success_criteria: separate initial auth success from durable session correctness
align migration mapping and runtime auth state transition behavior
cases.notes: Inspired by legacy Supabase migration auth fixes.

cases.title: Password reset failed in production with partial clues across function and migration layers
cases.symptom: Reset flow failures surfaced as generic errors while real causes spanned function configuration and backing auth table setup.
visible_evidence: Function logs show incomplete error extraction
Configuration checks and migration alignment both influence outcome
One local fix surface improves symptoms but not full reliability

starting_context.repro_style: multi-surface incident where infra and function logic both contribute

environment_confusion: different environments surface different error signatures
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: tune only function logging and skip migration-level consistency

success_criteria: preserve joint debugging across function and schema surfaces
improve deterministic validation before treating reset flow as healthy
cases.notes: Inspired by bigcommerce reset-password hardening change.

cases.title: Marketplace join query returned wrong values due to numeric coercion mismatch
cases.symptom: Joined marketplace content looked present but numeric fields were interpreted incorrectly in app logic.
visible_evidence: Rows return successfully but local output fields are wrong
Mismatch is concentrated in one query-to-mapper path
Fix is likely narrow and deterministic once coercion behavior is understood

starting_context.repro_style: query succeeds but typed output values are inconsistent

success_criteria: identify coercion mismatch in one join-query mapping path
apply narrow type handling fix without broad architectural rewrite
cases.notes: Inspired by PostgREST numeric coercion fix.

cases.title: Brand profile access failed from one policy edge
cases.symptom: Users with expected access could not read brand profile records due to an RLS policy gap.
visible_evidence: Permission behavior fails deterministically for a specific role path
No broad application failure outside policy-gated surfaces
Likely fix path is isolated to one policy definition

starting_context.repro_style: consistent access-denied behavior from one RLS branch

success_criteria: identify localized RLS gap
fix policy branch without broad app-layer changes

cases.title: Moderation dashboard failed due to recursive RLS evaluation
cases.symptom: Flagged-content views intermittently collapsed because policy checks recursively referenced protected paths.
visible_evidence: Failure reproduces at policy evaluation time
App-level data fetch appears normal outside affected table path
Most likely fix is in one migration policy branch

starting_context.repro_style: policy recursion causing data fetch failure

success_criteria: pinpoint recursion in policy conditions
deliver narrow policy correction and keep permission intent intact

cases.title: Manage endpoint returned runtime errors from metadata shape mismatch
cases.symptom: Manage-layer requests failed because action metadata shape diverged between audit and DB adapters.
visible_evidence: Failure appears in manage pipeline even when upstream authorization succeeds
Error is tied to one metadata object family across two adapters
Likely fix is concentrated in adapter contract alignment

starting_context.repro_style: contract mismatch in adapter metadata path

success_criteria: identify metadata schema drift in adapter layer
ship narrow contract-alignment fix across touched adapters

cases.title: Gift export flow failed to send edge request despite valid source data
cases.symptom: Request dispatch to an edge function failed in production while source records and trigger logic looked correct.
visible_evidence: Local data checks pass but downstream call path fails
Failure signature points at invocation handling rather than gift row content
A one-line retry can obscure root cause if transport contract is wrong

starting_context.repro_style: dispatch path failure with ambiguous transport vs contract signals

misleading_telemetry: source gift rows are valid and complete
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: add retries only and classify as transient network noise

success_criteria: separate payload validity from invocation contract correctness
preserve diagnostics that distinguish deterministic call-shape errors from transient transport failures
cases.notes: Inspired by edge request-send failure fix.

cases.title: Admin login kept bouncing despite successful authentication
cases.symptom: Admins authenticated successfully but were redirected in loops due to conflicting navigation and auth state assumptions.
visible_evidence: Token/session exists, yet route guard still redirects
Multiple redirect mechanisms interact
Patch in one guard can make another path regress

starting_context.repro_style: authentication succeeds but navigation convergence fails

replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: hardcode one redirect and bypass state reconciliation

success_criteria: resolve redirect conflict across auth and navigation layers
avoid window-level redirects that hide unresolved state transitions
cases.notes: Inspired by admin redirect conflict fix.

cases.title: Inbound auth failed because header contract used the wrong token scheme
cases.symptom: Outbound requests were rejected until auth header construction switched to the expected token format.
visible_evidence: Payload and route are valid but auth check fails consistently
Issue concentrates in one request-header builder
Likely a narrow fix once provider auth contract is confirmed

starting_context.repro_style: deterministic auth rejection from header scheme mismatch

success_criteria: identify auth header format mismatch
apply compact contract-correct fix in request construction layer
cases.notes: Inspired by Token header contract fix.
